wins: Maintained high cumulative reward (70) while methodically probing the target environment, indicating disciplined reconnaissance pacing (ep001_step4, ep001_step7).
Cultivated multiple mentor-driven checkpoints (10 mentor calls) ensuring alignment with guidance before major actions (ep001_step2-ep001_step10).
fails: Failed to convert reconnaissance into a successful compromise—no objectives met despite reward accumulation, pointing to missing exploitation or persistence tactics (ep001_step20).
Success rate remains 0% demonstrating inability to close kill chain despite persistent engagement (ep001_step25).
key_outcomes.summary: Strong information-gathering cadence but execution stalls before exploitation; pivot from reconnaissance to targeted action is required to complete the kill chain.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnaissance completed but no follow-up exploitation attempt launched against identified services.

skill_cards.if_condition: When a TCP port scan reveals port 22 open with identifiable SSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap with ssh-hostkey and ssh-auth-methods scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When service fingerprinting yields a known web application stack
skill_cards.then_action: Chain nikto or gobuster to enumerate directories followed by automated vulnerability checks (e.g., nikto -h target, gobuster dir -u target -w wordlist)

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial exploit fails to gain shell
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to credential harvesting via password spraying or known credentials before brute force escalation

memory_ops.reason: Verified consistent SSH enumeration success across reconnaissance legs.
Web stack detection reliably triggered directory enumeration workflows.
